harness.note: the real machine code; the presentation callees are replaced by recorders (their arguments are the calls lists); every character structure was filled with random bytes before each run

name: turn_ticks_start
notes: holder rows are [inBattle, dead, stone (0xdce), silent (0xdcb), reentered (0x716), hp, maxHp, perm, extra, autoExtra, tickCounter (0x6d2), p5c5, p5c6, flag 0xddb, counters[13]]; a slot not listed is a blank character (all zero, link bytes 0xff).
out.changed lists only the characters whose row differs from the input row (a blank one when absent from the input).
start: calls keeps num (damage numbers: id, 0, signed amount ...), event (id, counter slot, value), stance (id, chr) and dcd (the death check) in call order.
